text.guide_title: Plain-Language Guide to the Imaging Review
text.guide_banner: **This document explains the AI preliminary report above; it is not a separate diagnosis or an official physician report.**
text.g_how_to_read_text: This guide is a plain-language account of a computer-assisted preliminary review. Each section states what was seen, what it means, what remains uncertain and which questions you may ask your physician. No sentence here is a diagnosis on its own; the final assessment belongs to the physician who reviews the images. A listed finding is not bad news by itself; many findings are harmless or simply need follow-up.
